description: Funds transfer where a TransferPolicy domain service owns the daily-limit rule that spans two Account aggregates and the transfer history; TransferFunds withdraws and records FundsTransferred in one aggregate transaction, and a handler credits the destination

hard.note: Business rules in a service class look like an anemic model or logic in an application service, but the rule spans two aggregates, so a domain service legitimately owns it, and the entities keep their own invariants

_calibration.note: Clean counterpart to dm-logic-in-ui; zero findings expected. Opus stress run 20261116T110405Z reported 3-6 issues on the earlier fixture, which never recorded the transfer (the daily limit never accumulated) and saved two aggregates in one transaction; both fixed
